verdict.rationale: LangSmith documents agent traces and lets developers inspect threads and runs in Messages, Turns, and Details views. It can unify traces across services, accepts OpenTelemetry spans, and a hands-on user confirms full step-by-step traces through an agent graph with per-step inputs and outputs. One community comment says it only shows LLM inferences, but another hands-on report directly contradicts this, so it lowers confidence rather than creating a dispute. Missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of the nested run/span hierarchy, details on how runs are grouped into sessions or threads (e.g., thread ID configuration), and independent corroboration of thread grouping.
